newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: IWS says will launch sub-brands in wool fightback.
newsitem.headline: IWS says will launch sub-brands in wool fightback.

text.p: The International Wool Secretariat (IWS) said it planned to launch sub-brands in its generic Woolmark marketing programme.

Market research in 1996 showed Woolmark as the second most-recognised global brand (recognised by 75 percent of those surveyed), after Mercedes Benz (77 percent) and before McDonalds (72 percent) and Nike (55 percent), which were ranked third and fourth respectively, the IWS told the Australian wool forum.
Sub-brands would highlight specific wool types, new wool blends and innovative product developments, IWS said.
A flexible IWS strategy would allow each region to differentiate and promote the marketing programmes and product types most relevant to their markets, it said.
A 'merino extrafine' sub-brand would endorse very fine, premium, quality wools principally used in menswear, for fine knitwear, suiting and in top collections, it said.

A second sub-brand, 'pure merino wool', would support premium quality wools that offered softness and next-to-the-skin comfort, used widely in knitwear and wovens and often associated with more casual styliong, it said.
